title: Fruit Catcher
description: Fruit is raining from the trees! Slide your basket to catch apples, bananas and berries, but dodge the rotten ones. Catch combos to multiply your score.
instructions: Move the basket with the arrow keys or A and D.
On touch screens, drag your finger left and right.
Catch fruit to score. Avoid the brown rotten fruit.
You have 3 hearts. Press P to pause.
